text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenekadā devo vassatīti || || 4 Santi bhikkhu Vassavalāhakā nāma devā || || Tesaṃ yadā evaṃ hoti Yaṃ nuna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti || tesantaṃ cetopaṇidhim anvāya devo vassati || || 5 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenekadā devo vassatīti || || Valāha-saṃyuttaṃ ||
